title: President of India
quote: Election: elected MLAs vote, nominated MPs do not; impeachment: nominated MPs take part, elected MLAs do not

boxes.title: Election method
items: ==**PR by Single Transferable Vote**==, secret ballot; from **Ireland** (Art. 55(3))
MLA vote = State population / elected MLAs x **1/1000**; varies State to State
MP vote = total MLA votes / elected MPs → **parity** Union-States
Disputes: **Supreme Court** only (**Art. 71**); vacancy in college no bar

boxes.title: Qualifications, term, oath
items: **Art. 58**: citizen, ==**35** years==, qualified for **Lok Sabha**, no office of profit
Emoluments: **Consolidated Fund**, Second Schedule; not diminished

boxes.title: Impeachment (Art. 61)
steps: Charge in either House: signed by **1/4** members, **14 days'** notice
Other House investigates, passes by **2/3** → impeached

boxes.title: Powers
items: **Executive**: appoints PM, Governors, judges, **CAG**, **AG**, UPSC, ECs; **Art. 78** info from PM
**Legislative**: part of Parliament (**Art. 79**); summon, dissolve LS, joint sitting; address **Arts. 86, 87**; nominates **12** to RS; ordinance **Art. 123**
**Financial**: money bills on recommendation; Contingency Fund

boxes.title: Pardoning terms
head: Term
Meaning
rows: Governor: no **court-martial**, no pardon of death sentence

boxes.title: Position (Art. 74)
items: **74(2)**: advice not inquired into by court

cards.title: Firsts
lines: **K.R. Narayanan**: Dalit; **Pratibha Patil**: woman; **Droupadi Murmu** (**15th**): tribal

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Both posts vacant → **CJI** acts (Act **1969**); **M. Hidayatullah** only CJI to act
